data.creative: Mum and daughter compare painful freezing with painless drops · 4332672960298409
data.hook: Her warts dried up, flaked off within three weeks time.
data.desire: Get rid of my child's warts without the pain of freezing.
data.angle: A mother reports the result, then her young daughter tells how freezing hurt and the drops do not.
data.belief_shift: from wart removal for kids means painful freezing → to a home drop that does not hurt and (claim) keeps warts from coming back
data.script_structure: Mum states result (3 weeks, never returned) → hand before-after → child recalls freezing pain (bee sting) → child says this does not hurt → 'So you love it? Yes' → mum recommends → social-proof montage of other kids → Shop Now end card
data.mechanism_reveal: None explained; only 'dried up, flaked off' (advertiser claim of result, no reason why).
data.proof: Parent testimonial at open; before-after hand photos at 2-4s; child's own pain comparison 6-17s; montage of other families 21-24s; 'thousands of families' claim.
data.cta: Tap Shop now to get yours today. (no offer stated in video)
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: The child's unscripted-sounding 'bee sting' line makes the pain of the old method vivid and believable in a way an adult claim would not. The result claim comes first, so the rest of the ad is proof of a promise already made.
data.transferable_move: Let the end user who suffered the old method describe its pain in their own words, then have them try the new product on camera and say it does not hurt. Soften: talk about comfort and the routine, not removal or 'never returned'.
data.opening_visual: Woman in her 30s talking to selfie camera in a home with kids' art on the wall; caption 'Her warts dried up'.
data.transition_to_product: Bottle first seen in the child's hand at about 14s as she says 'This does not hurt at all'.
data.proof_placement: Before-after photos follow the result claim (2-4s); child testimonial follows; family montage follows the recommendation, right before the CTA.
